profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to tackle automation challenges and change ideas about what robots can do. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It is a for-profit public company.

Its site highlights Stretch, a robot used to streamline case handling and warehouse automation, which the company describes as easy to deploy and flexible. The site also offers white papers and eBooks on the development, implementation, and value of robots and automation solutions.

Litigation exposure for the company is recorded in Massachusetts, with 143 cases.
